name: lp-booking
description: Booking page: a heading and lede over one white card holding the event details (logo, event name, duration, description) beside an inline scheduler, on the soft colour wash. The scheduler is a Calendly inline widget or a Cal.com inline embed, mounted when the card nears the viewport. Live: the /calendly-booking-page-*/ pages (bs-section--thank-you-calendar, Calendly or Cal.com).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title.description: Page heading (h1) above the card. Empty makes the event name the h1.

background.description: Wash picture URL, drawn cover-sized. Empty draws the kit's soft gradient.

logo.description: Logo above the event name (live: the Asset Panda Pro logo).

logo_width.description: Logo intrinsic width in px. 0 omits it.

logo_height.description: Logo intrinsic height in px. 0 omits it.

event_title.description: Event name, e.g. Asset Panda Demo.

duration.description: Meeting length beside a clock, e.g. 30 min. Empty hides the line.

provider.description: calendly: a Calendly inline widget (calendly_url). cal: a Cal.com inline embed (cal_link).

calendly_url.description: Calendly scheduling link (https://calendly.com/…, query string kept, e.g. hide_event_type_details=1).

cal_namespace.description: Cal.com embed namespace (live: asset-panda-demo, asset-panda-pricing). Empty uses the last part of cal_link.

height.description: Scheduler height in px on desktop (taller on phones).

hide_international.description: Hide the card for international visitors (html.ap-intl), as the legacy thank-you calendars do.

contact_email.description: Shown under the card, with the phone, for anyone who cannot book online. Empty hides the line.

contact_phone.description: Phone number for the line under the card.
